# model-card-gen

> Generate model cards in Markdown from structured JSON following the Mitchell et al. sections, with validation, Decimal metric tables and subgroup disparity notes Python package `trysac-model-card-gen`, import name `model_card_gen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
